auth.verify.subject: Confirm your email address
auth.verify.body: Your confirmation code is {code}. It expires in 24 hours.
auth.reset.subject: Reset your password
auth.reset.body: Your reset code is {code}. It expires in 15 minutes. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message.
auth.security.passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
auth.security.passwordChanged.body: Your account password was just changed and your other sessions were signed out. If this was not you, reset your password immediately.
auth.security.sessionsRevoked.subject: Your sessions were signed out
auth.security.sessionsRevoked.body: Unusual activity was detected on your account and every session was signed out as a precaution. Sign in again and change your password.
email.footer: This is an automated message, please do not reply.
